decisions.decision: Continuous autonomous development along the canonical roadmap: Gate A -> implementation -> Gate B -> CI -> independent review -> auto-merge -> checkpoint -> next PR, without per-step owner confirmation. One implementation PR at a time; read-only audits, reviews and planning may run in parallel. Issues needed only to track already-approved roadmap work may be created. A blocked activity is recorded with evidence and work moves to the next independent authorized activity. Stop only for new substantive owner decisions, costs, deploys, production changes, ambiguous approved requirements, unsatisfiable gates, missing independent review, data-loss risk or unreconcilable GitHub conflicts. No cost, deploy, LIVE, real-money trading or archive modification; only the owner closes issues.

decisions.decision: Migrations and auto-deploy: developing and testing migrations on isolated PostgreSQL is authorized; merging certified migrations is authorized; migrations on the production database are not authorized automatically; no production migration while auto-deploy and migrations are not coordinated; no implicit automatic deploy in a merge; verify that a merge does not trigger unwanted production effects; a production migration needs backup, compatibility, a recovery plan and owner authorization. If the repository or infrastructure allows automatic deploys after a merge, stop before a potentially impacting merge and report the risk.
